extraction.Name: George S. Gover
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record; yes, receipted for
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to C. E. Vandervoort, Sr.; Sold to J. E. Lowry, for $8000.00 and paid off the mortgage, leaving allottee $2000.00
extraction.Buyer: Sold to J. E. Lowry for $8000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Mortgage paid off by allottee; Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: No inherited interest. income from annuity paid to Pawnee Indians.
extraction.NOTES: Good health. Wife and five children. No property or funds accumulated. The allottee does not feel like he was defrauded of his land. Mortgage was during 1918; date of redemption expired; mortgage paid off by allottee. Document notarized November 26, 1928, before notary public, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31st 1929. File reference: 81391 / 6074.
